title.narrative: Study of the withdrawal of the shoreline of Lake Niassa - Final project audit

description.narrative: Financing of study of the shore of Lake Niassa. The shoreline has exhibited withdrawal during 2023, leading to damage on nature and infrastructure.
Finansiering till studie av Niassasjöns strandkant då den dragit sig tillbaka kraftigt under 2023. Tillbakadragandet har orsakat skada på natur och infrastruktur längs sjön.
